name: Sourcewise Meals on Wheels
description: Sourcewise provides Meals on Wheels throughout Santa Clara County, delivering a weekly box of frozen meals and extras to homebound seniors who can't shop or cook for themselves.
fullDescription: Sourcewise provides Meals on Wheels throughout Santa Clara County, delivering a weekly box of frozen meals and extras to homebound seniors who can't shop or cook for themselves.
whatTheyOffer:
- 5 frozen meals delivered once a week, plus bread, fruit, milk, juice, and breakfast items
- Meals meet 2/3 of daily nutritional needs for seniors and are low in sodium and sugar
- Microwave loaned if you don't have one
- Fixed menu (special diets can't be accommodated)
- Suggested contribution of $3/day ($90/month), but no one is denied meals
howToGetIt: Call Sourcewise at 408-350-3200, option 1 (Mon-Fri 8am-5pm) or fill out the online interest form. You must be 60+, live in Santa Clara County, and be homebound and unable to shop or cook due to illness or disability. Intake is done by phone, and meals can start in about 5-7 days.
keywords: Sourcewise, Meals on Wheels, Santa Clara County, home delivered meals, senior meals, homebound, frozen meals, weekly delivery
